- **Fiscal 2024:** gross profit was about $17.45 billion.
- **Fiscal 2025:** adding my recalled quarterly gross profits (about $2.8B, $3.9B, $5.05B and $5.0B) gives roughly $16.7 billion.

The change is about (16.7 − 17.45) / 17.45 ≈ −4.3%.
